decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks extend the firm's existing dental thermoforming and custom-device manufacturing knowledge, so it can interpret early results and improve them.
PETG thermoforming blanks fit the firm's established materials and dental laboratory workflow capabilities, enabling assimilation of market feedback.
UV-curing lacquer complements the firm's materials and in-house R&D knowledge in dental applications, allowing the firm to learn from and refine the product.
Intraoral contrast spray supports the firm's digital clinical workflow solutions and benefits from its existing dental and R&D capabilities.
Custom earmolds build directly on the firm's skilled custom medical-device manufacturing and hearing-care channel knowledge.
Custom hearing protection earmolds rely on the same existing custom earmold and hearing-care expertise, allowing learning and refinement.
